settings.title: PURPOSE
settings.subtitle: Inspiring Visible Confidence
settings.content: To help people feel more confident in how they look by creating science-led personal care that delivers meaningful, visible improvement.

settings.title: MISSION
settings.subtitle: Disciplined High-Performance
settings.content: To build focused, high-performance systems for hair, scalp and skin that address real-world concerns with thoughtfully selected ingredients, intelligent formulation and clear, evidence-conscious communication. We aim to make advanced personal care easier to understand and easier to use — without exaggerated promises, unnecessary complexity or trend-led formulation.

settings.title: VISION
settings.subtitle: A Global Indian Standard
settings.content: To build Prüv into a globally relevant Indian personal-care brand at the intersection of science, performance and modern aesthetics — creating products for hair, skin, scalp and appearance that are designed around how people actually live.

settings.heading: Engineered for Confidence. BEYOND DOUBT
settings.lead_text: At Prüv, we believe confidence is built on visible results, credible science and products that earn their place in your routine.
settings.principle_quote: Every claim should have a reason, every ingredient should have a role, and every product should have something to Prüv.

settings.heading: Three co-founders. One shared standard.
settings.text:
Prüv was created by Indian founders for modern routines - with a simple belief: personal care should make people feel more certain about what they are using, why it works, and how it fits into their lives.

We are building Prüv as a proof-led personal care house rooted in clarity, restraint and visible confidence. Our ambition is not to become another label built on trends, fear or exaggerated promises. Prüv exists to bring discipline to categories where consumers are often left confused by overclaims, ingredient noise and one-size-fits-all solutions.

We begin with haircare because modern Indian hair faces a connected set of daily stressors - hard water, pollution, humidity, heat, styling, scalp imbalance and breakage. These concerns rarely exist in isolation. They work together, affecting how hair looks, feels, behaves and ultimately how confident people feel in their everyday lives.

Our first ritual is built around three focused steps: Reset what daily exposure leaves behind. Repair the feel of weakened lengths. Support the scalp environment and visible density confidence.

Each Prüv product is designed with a clear role, advanced cosmetic actives and plain-English science. We believe care should be intelligent without being intimidating, premium without being excessive, and effective without relying on miracle language.

Haircare is our starting point. The larger vision is broader: to build a globally relevant Indian appearance-optimization brand for hair, skin, scalp and personal confidence.

Prüv is for people who want more than products. It is for people who want understanding, consistency and confidence built into the ritual.

Quiet science. Visible confidence. Beyond Doubt.

settings.heading: The biology of better care.
settings.text:
We design solutions that reach the source of the concern, turning bioscience into formulations that outlast quick fixes.

Each formula is shaped through structured research, rigorous ingredient evaluation, and continuous testing and refinement — relevance over trends, performance over perception.

settings.title: Listen first
settings.description: We start by researching the real concerns Indian hair and scalp actually face, before a single ingredient is chosen.

settings.title: Define the challenge
settings.description: Insights are shaped into a structured brief with clear, measurable performance goals.

settings.title: Engineer with intent
settings.description: High-efficacy actives are chosen and combined based on how they actually behave on hair and scalp.

settings.title: Test for performance
settings.description: Each formula runs through internal trials and safety assessments before it goes anywhere near a customer.

settings.title: Validate at scale
settings.description: Results are confirmed through real usage across different water types, climates and hair types.

settings.title: Deliver with precision
settings.description: Validated formulas are produced under controlled conditions, with the same quality checks on every batch.

settings.heading: Insight-led. Intentionally built.
settings.text: Every formula follows the same disciplined path from question to shelf.

settings.heading: Precision at every step.
settings.text:
Our manufacturing process is built around control, consistency and quality. From sourcing and formulation to production and packaging, every stage follows strict checks to ensure safety, stability and performance.

Each batch is held to the same standard, so you get the same quality every time.

settings.heading: The ones who stand behind Prüv.
settings.text: A small, multidisciplinary team spanning research, formulation, design and operations — all working toward the same standard.

settings.title: It Started With a Question
settings.description: Why should high-performance personal care be complicated, overpromised or disconnected from the conditions people actually live in?

settings.title: We Chose to Build Differently
settings.description: Prüv was created around a simple idea: combine credible science, purposeful formulation and elevated design — without relying on exaggerated claims or unnecessary complexity.

settings.title: We Focused on the Real Environment
settings.description: Hard water. Pollution. Scalp imbalance. Hair fall. Breakage. We began by looking at the everyday factors that affect how hair actually behaves, rather than treating every concern in isolation.

settings.title: The System Took Shape
settings.description: From that thinking came our first haircare system: RESET · SUPPORT · REPAIR — three focused steps designed to cleanse the environment, support the root and restore the fibre.

settings.title: Every Detail Was Refined
settings.description: Formulations, actives, textures, packaging and claims were repeatedly reviewed with one standard in mind: every ingredient should have a role, and every product should justify its place in the routine.

settings.title: This Is Only the Beginning
settings.description: Prüv begins with hair and scalp, but the ambition is broader: to build a globally relevant Indian personal-care brand for hair, skin and appearance — grounded in science, performance and modern design.

settings.eyebrow: Built with Intent. From Question to System
settings.heading: Shaped by curiosity and commitment to performance beyond doubt.
